macro_cross_check: Source (feelgoodfoodie, 4 servings) publishes 401 cal / 35 carbs / 40 protein. My recompute over all 14 lines with 99/1 ground turkey: 1470 cal total = 368 cal, 40.2 g protein, 32.2 g carbs per serving. Protein is within 0.5% and calories 8% under, so the portions are right. With 93/7 turkey instead, protein falls to 34.2 (14.5% miss) and calories rise to 438 - the lean grade is what the source's own label pins. Band check: 368 cal (in 350-650), 32.2 carbs (<=35), 40.2 protein (>=40). It PASSES but only barely on both protein and the calorie floor; any downward revision of the turkey line or the mozzarella will put it out of band.
